verdict.rationale: NVIDIA B300 is GPU accelerator hardware sold as DGX/HGX server systems. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is a workflow-software capability that a buyer comparing GPU hardware would not reasonably ask about. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any automation-management feature that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
